subject: Water plane and weather systems (CWaterManager, CWeather, CTimeCycle)

water_plane.overview: Water in GTA:SA is rendered as a height-mapped mesh defined by data/water.dat. CWaterManager reads the file at startup and builds a 2-D grid of water quads. The water surface scrolls and animates using two animated normal-map textures (waterclear128.txd) and is rendered after opaque scene geometry.

record_types.QUAD: 4-corner water patch: x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 x3 y3 z3 depth
record_types.VERT: single water vertex override at x y z

weather_system.overview: CWeather interpolates between two named weather types (OldWeatherType / NewWeatherType) using a fractional blend value. Weather transitions are scheduled by a weather script table (timecyc.dat) and can be overridden by SCM script.

timecycle.overview: timecyc.dat defines per-hour, per-weather-type sky/lighting parameters. CTimeCycle reads the file at startup and populates a 192-entry table (12 hours × 16 weather types). At runtime the active entry is interpolated with the blend ratio for smooth day/night transitions.
timecycle.column_meanings: sky top RGB, sky bottom RGB, sun core/corona/ambient RGB, cloud RGB, water R/G/B, fog start/end, post-processing parameters; see timecyc.dat header comments.
